text: How Pick'Ems Works | Hotspawn Play Lobby My Picks Leaderboard Tournaments How To Play HOW IT WORKS Hotspawn Pick'Ems is your chance to predict, compete and win. Make your picks, earn points and climb the leaderboard for a shot at weekly prizes. 1. Make Your Picks Browse upcoming matches and pick the team you think will win. Picks lock 5 minutes before the scheduled start time, so make sure you submit before the countdown reaches zero. 2. Earn Points Earn points for every correct pick. Higher tier matches reward more points. The better you predict, the higher you climb. 3. Build Winning Streaks Get bonus points for consecutive correct picks. The longer your streak, the bigger the bonus. 4. Climb the Leaderboard Compete against other players and rise through the ranks. The leaderboard resets every week so everyone has a fresh chance to be #1. 5. Win Weekly Prizes Top performing players can win exclusive weekly prizes including voucher codes. 6. How Winners Are Contacted Winners will be contacted via the registered account email with instructions on how to claim their prizes. FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS What are Hotspawn Pick’ems? Hotspawn Pick’ems are free prediction games where you can test your esports knowledge by predicting match and tournament outcomes. Earn points for correct predictions, climb the leaderboard, and compete against other fans throughout the event. Do I need a Hotspawn account to play? Yes. You need a Hotspawn account to create and save your picks, track your score, and appear on the leaderboard. Does it cost anything to enter? No. Hotspawn Pick’ems are completely free to play. There is no entry fee. Can I change my picks after submitting them? Yes. You can change your picks at any time before they lock. Once a pick has locked, it can no longer be changed. When do my picks lock? Your picks lock 5 minutes before the scheduled start time of the relevant match or game. Make sure you submit or update your predictions before the countdown reaches zero. What happens to my Pick’ems predictions if a match is forfeited? If a match is forfeited, all predictions for that match are voided. No points are awarded or deducted, including for correct winner predictions, exact score predictions, or match statistics predictions. Your picks will be marked as Voided in your pick history. What happens to my Pick’ems predictions if a match is cancelled? If a match is cancelled, all predictions for that match are cancelled. No points are awarded or deducted, and the predictions will be marked as Cancelled in your pick history. These predictions will not count towards your points or leaderboard ranking.
